faq_a1: Yes. The app is free to download for everyone. Owners pay per booking; sitters and walkers receive their full advertised rate.
faq_a10: Yes. Sign up for a new role with the same email: your identity, phone, address, card and IBAN are carried over automatically, and your subscriptions (PawFollow, PawSpot, PawPremium, Family) keep their remaining days on every profile. One account, three profiles.
faq_a11: Points that reward your activity on HoPetSit: Walks, plushies caught, PawSpots added, reviews received… They raise your level and can be exchanged for perks in the app.
faq_a12: By being active on the PawMap: finish a Walk, catch a plushie, add a PawSpot or a photo, receive your first review, complete your profile… The full list, with the points for each action, is on the site's PawPoints page.
faq_a13: For PawBoost (your profile featured on the map), a gold frame around your photo, or free subscription days (PawFollow, PawSpot, Paw Premium). The cost of each reward is shown on the PawPoints page.
faq_a14: No. PawPoints are earned only through your activity. They can't be bought and are never worth money: they can't be turned into euros or dollars.
faq_a15: In the public parks of your city. They appear on the PawMap only during an ongoing Walk, a few per city each day.
faq_a16: Start a Walk in the app, then get within 30 metres of a plushie: it's yours, with PawPoints. One plushie per person per day. Watch where you walk.
faq_a17: There are 5 plushies (teddy bear, bunny, kitten, puppy, fox). The golden plushie is rare: one per city per week, it earns more PawPoints and free PawBoost. Collecting all 5 gives a bonus and the “Collector” badge. Everything is on the PawPoints page.
faq_a18: Every sitter and walker has their own page: hopetsit.com/s/… with their rates and reviews. You can send it to your neighbours and clients (WhatsApp, text, email) or print your poster with a QR code. They book you and pay securely on HoPetSit. It does not guarantee bookings.
faq_a19: A sitter or walker gets the “Pioneer” badge when nobody else offers their services within 25 km: they are the first in their area. It is a fact, not a promise of bookings.
faq_a2: Card payments are processed through a regulated payment provider. The funds are held until the service is delivered, then released to the provider's IBAN.
faq_a20: It appears when a sitter or walker has had their ID document checked by HoPetSit — not just their email address. On the PawMap it's a blue tick on their circle and a “✓ Verified” label on their card; the “Verified only” filter shows only them. It is not a guarantee of service quality: read the reviews too.
faq_a3: If a service is cancelled before delivery, the owner is refunded automatically. Disputes after delivery are reviewed by our team within 5 business days.
faq_a4: Worldwide — 177 countries including the USA, all of Europe, the United Kingdom, Switzerland and Norway. Anyone in those countries can sign up as owner, sitter or walker.
faq_a5: Complete at least 10 bookings with an average rating ≥ 4.7 stars. The badge unlocks a reduced 15% platform fee on every future booking.
faq_a6: Your PawFollow Family plan covers YOU + up to 5 invited members (6 people in total). Everyone follows your pet, the alerts and the live position on the same map — handy for spouses, grown-up kids or trusted friends.
faq_a7: Once a booking is paid, the owner taps “Track my pet” in the chat and the walker or sitter accepts in one tap — the live position appears instantly on the PawMap. Outside bookings, the PawFollow subscription (violet chip on the map) lets you follow your own pet and your family at any time. Tracking can be turned off whenever you want.
faq_a8: PawPremium is the all-in-one bundle: every PawFollow feature (live tracking) + every PawSpot feature (community map) + exclusives — 👑 Premium badge, double community points and priority on new features. €7.99/month or €59.99/year, 33% cheaper than the two subscriptions separately.
faq_a9: The community subscription of the PawMap: tag pet-friendly spots (walks, cafés, beaches…), earn PawPoints and badges, climb the country leaderboards and unlock rewards. €4.99/month · €39.99/year, with a 7-day free trial.

h587_a1: Check three things: the “Friends” chip is on in “What I want to see”; your friend accepted your request; they did not choose “Hidden” (crossed-out eye). A friend who is not sharing appears at their profile position, blurred to about 1 km, with “seen … ago”; when live, they appear at their exact GPS position.
h587_a2: It depends on the eye. “Everyone”: everybody sees your profile position, blurred to about 1 km. “Friends only”: only your friends. “Hidden”: nobody, not even your friends, and your live position is sent to no one. When you are live, your friends see your exact GPS position in real time.
h587_a3: Your friend is live, but their position has not arrived for more than 2 minutes (network or GPS cut off). Their circle stays at the last known position. After 10 minutes without news, it shows “seen … ago”.
h587_a4: A bar may be put away: tap the tab on the edge of the map to bring it back. Some buttons (SOS, Share the map, Layers, History) only exist in the app.
h587_b_around: In the left-hand bar. Tap it for the list of useful places near you (vets, parks, water points…), with a directions button to get there.
h587_b_chat: In the left-hand bar. Tap it to open your messages and write to a sitter, a walker, an owner or a friend.
h587_b_direct: The pill at the top left. Live sharing starts and stops in the HoPetSit app, on your phone; here it shows whether it is on (green) and since when. Tap it for the explanation.
h587_b_directions: First choose a destination (a place from the list or a friend you follow), then tap “Directions”: the route on foot, by bike or by car appears. Without a destination, the map opens the “Around you” list.
h587_b_eye: In the right-hand bar. Each tap moves to the next choice: eye = everyone sees you (at your profile position, blurred to about 1 km); eye with a heart = only your friends; crossed-out eye = nobody, not even your friends. The choice is saved on your account, in the app and on the website.
h587_b_fade: When you drag the map, the buttons turn see-through so you can see. They come back as soon as you let go.
h587_b_feed: In the right-hand bar, just above the Walk button. Tap it to see every report around you: lost pet, aggressive dog, hazard… Worth a look before going for a walk.
h587_b_friends: The pink “Friends” button opens your friends, the requests you received and your PawFamily. Add someone as a friend to see their exact position when they are live and follow their walks.
h587_b_handle: The “Options” pill with a paw, at the bottom of the map. Tap it to open the full panel: What I want to see, friends, subscriptions and lists. Tap its handle again to put it away.
h587_b_live_friends: In Options, the live friends section lists the friends sharing their position right now, marked “live” or “signal lost”. Tap a friend and the map follows them.
h587_b_locate: The round button in your role's colour, in the right-hand bar. Tap it to centre the map on you again, for example after moving it. Location access must be allowed.
h587_b_members: In the right-hand bar (people icon). Tap it to show or hide HoPetSit members on the map; tap again to bring them back.
h587_b_night: The moon button at the top right. Tap it to darken the map, easier on the eyes at night; tap the sun to go back to day. The choice stays in this browser.
h587_b_photo: In the left-hand bar (camera). Tap it and take or add a photo of the place: it becomes a PawSpot on the map, so others can discover it.
h587_b_pins: The memo above tells you what each shape means. Tap a pin to open its card (person, place, PawSpot…). Tap a group (with a number) and the map zooms in to split the points, or shows the list if they are in the same spot.
h587_b_publish: The red round button with a megaphone, at the bottom of the right-hand bar. Tap it to post your pet-sitting or walk request: sitters and walkers around you are notified and can reply.
h587_b_report: In the left-hand bar (triangle). Tap it, show the place, choose what is happening (aggressive dog, lost pet, hazard…) and send. Members around see it for 48 h.
h587_b_sat: In the right-hand bar. Tap it to switch from the map to photos seen from the sky, handy for spotting a path or a park. Tap again to go back to the map.
h587_b_search: The magnifying glass at the top of the map. Type the name of a city and the map moves there. Useful to plan a trip or see who looks after pets elsewhere.
h587_b_see: In Options, one chip per family: friends, owners, sitters, walkers, places, PawSpots, reports, requests. Tap a chip to hide or show only that family; “All” and “None” are quicker. It does not change who sees you.
h587_b_spots: In the left-hand bar. Tap it for the list of PawSpots around you: places recommended by the community (walks, parks, cafés…).
h587_b_subs: In Options, “My subscriptions”: one line per subscription (PawFollow, PawSpot, PawPremium). The switch shows or hides its layer on the map; “Discover” opens the shop if you don't have it yet.
h587_b_tag: In the left-hand bar. Tap it, show the place on the map, add the details, then confirm: the place is shared with the community.
h587_b_zoom: In the right-hand bar. Tap + to see your street up close, − to see the whole city or country. You can also zoom with two fingers (or the mouse wheel on a computer).
h587_ex_act: A stray dog near the park: tap “Report”, show the place, choose the type, then send. Members around know about it for 48 h.
h587_ex_find: You need a vet: tap “Around me”, pick one from the list, then start the walking directions.
h587_ex_live_owner: You want only your close ones to see you: tap the eye in the right-hand bar until you see the eye with a heart (“Friends only”).
h587_ex_live_walker: You're taking Rex for a walk: tap “Live” in the app on your phone. Here, the pill turns green and your friends see your circle move in real time.
h587_ex_see: You only want to see dog walkers: open Options, tap “None” in “What I want to see”, then turn on “Dog walkers”.
h587_ex_set: The map feels crowded: tap the arrow on the edge of the left-hand bar to put it away. The tab brings it back whenever you want.
h587_intro: Every button on the map, explained simply: what it does, why use it and the exact gesture.

h601_b_direct: The Walk button, in the right bar (black: stopped, green: on a walk). A walk starts and stops in the HoPetSit app, on your phone; here, during the walk, a green badge above the button shows for how many minutes and how many people are following you. Tap the button for the explanation.
h601_ex_live_walker: You're taking Rex for a walk: tap “Walk” in the app on your phone. Here, the Walk button turns green, a “12 min” badge appears just above it, and your friends see your circle move in real time.
help599_b_dot: Without opening the map: the white outline of the menu paw turns green as soon as a friend is live. It turns red if your own live is on but your position is no longer being sent (GPS or network lost). Tap the paw: the map opens. The outline goes back to white when nobody is live any more.
help599_b_me: Tap the Walk button (right bar). Your “Me” circle moves with you, a purple trail draws your path and a green badge, just above the button, shows how long you've been out and how many people follow you. Tap Walk again to finish: everything clears at once, on all your phones.
help599_b_others: Your friends, your family, and the owner during a booking in progress: your circle shows your photo, a breathing purple ring, the bubble “live · right now” and your trail. After 2 min without signal, the circle dims and shows “Seen X ago”; after 10 min, it disappears.
help599_ex_balade: Kathy is walking Rex: on her map, her “Me” circle moves and leaves a purple trail; on the right, a green badge above the Walk button shows “12 min” and how many people follow her. For her friends, Kathy is a circle with her photo, a purple ring and “live · right now”.

help607_pioneer_body:
Sitter or walker, you have your own page: hopetsit.com/s/your-name. Send it to your neighbours and clients (WhatsApp, text, email) or print your poster with its QR code: they see your rates and reviews and book you on HoPetSit.
If nobody else offers your services within 25 km, you get the “Pioneer” badge: you are the first in your area. The badge does not guarantee bookings; it shows you were there first.
help607_plush_body:
During a Walk, small plushies appear on the map, in public parks near you. Get within 30 metres: you catch it and it joins your collection, on the PawPoints page.
They are not worth money: only PawPoints and one more reason to go out. Watch where you walk.
help607_plush_bonus:
• Each plushie: +20 PawPoints (one a day).
• The golden plushie, rare (one per city per week): +200 PawPoints and 24 h of free PawBoost.
• The full collection of 5: +500 PawPoints and the “Collector” badge.
• 7 days in a row with a plushie: +200 PawPoints.
help609_verified_body: The blue check at the bottom right of a circle means the person had their ID checked by HoPetSit. It's not just a confirmed email. At the same price, verified members come first in "Around me", and the "Verified only" filter shows only them.

p589_b_custom: The white button with an orange border (arrows and pencil), at the bottom of the app's left bar. It opens “Customise my buttons”: one switch per button to show or hide it. To change the order, press and hold a row, then slide it. “Restore the original order” undoes everything.
p589_b_legendbtn: The first orange circle at the top right. It opens this page: every pin and every button on the map explained, with examples.
p589_b_night: In the options (the orange gear), the “Night mode” tool with the moon. Tap it to darken the map, gentler in the evening; tap the sun to go back to day. The choice stays on this browser.
p589_b_options: The orange gear at the top right, next to Refresh. It opens the options: your main button, “What I want to see”, shortcuts and your subscriptions. The cross puts them away.
p589_b_refresh: The orange circle with a circular arrow, at the top right. Tap it to reload the map right away: members, friends, places, PawSpots and reports. While loading, it turns into a small spinning circle.
p589_direct_account: Your live follows your account: started on one device, it shows “Live · other phone” elsewhere, and stopping it on one stops it everywhere.
p601_pawmap586_direct_help: Share your position live during a walk. Black: stopped. Green: live. One tap starts or stops it.
p601_pawmap586_vis_btn: Who sees me on the map
p601_pawmap586_vis_help: Eye: everyone sees you. Eye and heart: only your friends. Crossed-out eye: nobody. One tap moves to the next choice.
p601_pawmap601_everyone_help: Zooms the map out to show all your friends and family at once, wherever they are.
p601_pawmap601_satellite_help: Switches from the map to satellite (photos from the sky with street names), then back to the map.
p601_pawmap_rail_customize_sub: Choose the buttons and their order. Long-press a map button to learn what it does.

p601_pawmap_rail_help_live_friends: Who's live: your friends sharing their position. Tap one to follow them.
p601_pawmap_rail_help_photo: Take a photo of where you are to create a PawSpot.
p601_pawmap_rail_help_report: Report something around you (aggressive dog, lost pet, hazard…), visible 48 h.

page_desc_contact: A question, a problem with a booking, a partnership? Write to the HoPetSit team, we answer in your language.
page_desc_download: Get HoPetSit on the App Store and Google Play: PawMap, live tracking, secure booking and payment, in 9 languages.
page_desc_faq: Answers about bookings, payment, safety, identity verification, PawMap and subscriptions.
page_desc_home: HoPetSit: book trusted pet sitters and dog walkers near you, from the website or the app. Live PawMap, secure payment, verified identities.
page_desc_how: Search, book, pay securely and follow the service live: the 4 steps, for owners, sitters and walkers.
page_desc_ppg: How to earn PawPoints on HoPetSit (Walks, plushies, PawSpots, reviews), the levels and the rewards: PawBoost, gold frame, free subscription days. Never money.
page_desc_pricing: HoPetSit pricing: no fee for pet owners, a 20% commission on paid services for sitters and walkers, and optional PawFollow, PawSpot and PawPremium subscriptions.
page_title_home: Book a pet sitter or dog walker online
page_title_pawmap: PawMap — sitters and walkers near you
page_title_pricing: Pricing — free for owners, 20% commission for pros
pawfollow_desc: Unlock all PawMap features, real-time tracking and unlimited chat with your sitter / walker. With the live-follow button (on/off), you follow each other in real time — you follow me, I follow you.
pawfollow_family_f4: Family group chat with sitter / walker
pawfollow_monthly_f4: Directions to the free PawMap places (water points, parks, restaurants…) included
pawfollow_section_family_sub: Share tracking with up to 5 family members
pawmap_msg_places: 🐾 Pet-friendly parks, beaches, vets, restaurants and hotels
pawmap_pawpoints_desc: Every PawSpot you add, every photo and every confirmed report earns you PawPoints. Climb 7 levels (from Explorer to 👑 Paw Legend), unlock badges and bonuses, and trade your points for discounts or free months of subscription.
pawmap_public_places_note: In the app and on your connected map: vets, parks, water points, groomers, friends live and PawSpots.
pawmap_public_privacy: Approximate positions (~1 km), never the exact address.
pawmap_public_sub: Sitters and dog walkers, shown at an approximate location. Tap a pin to see the profile and book. Sign up to contact them.
pawmap_public_title: Who's around you, on the map
pawmap_step1: Explore the map: parks, beaches, vets, groomers, pet-friendly restaurants and hotels around you.
pawmap_sub: Vets, dog parks, beaches, water points, trainers, groomers, hotels and restaurants. Crowd-sourced and curated across 177 countries.
pawmap_title: PawMap — the pet-friendly world at a glance
pawpremium_feat_nearby: See nearby PawMap members around you (pink badge)
pawpremium_savings: ✨ Save 33% vs the two separate subscriptions
pawpremium_subtitle: The complete pack for pet lovers
pawspot_desc: PawSpot is the community layer of the PawMap: tag, share and discover the best pet-friendly spots (walks, swimming, playgrounds, pet-friendly cafés…). Earn PawPoints, unlock badges 🥉🥈🥇👑 and get the GOLDEN paw 🐾 on your best spots. You also see nearby PawMap members around you, marked with the pink 🌸 icon.
pawspot_feat_nearby: Nearby members: spot PawMap users around you (pink badge) — subscriber only.
pawspot_footer_note: 7-day free trial for new users. PawPoints: +10 per spot, +5 per photo, +10 community-validated, +25 very popular. Badges from Explorer 🥉 to PawMaster 👑.
pawspot_monthly_details: Unlimited spot tagging · all PawSpots · popular spots · point rewards
pawspot_yearly_details: Everything in Monthly, save 33% — the community at its best, all year long

pricing_owner_l3: Optional Premium for early access to top providers
pricing_provider_l1: Set your own rates (hourly, daily, weekly, monthly)
pricing_provider_l3: Top Sitter / Top Walker badge cuts platform fee from 20% → 15%
pricing_sub: No hidden fees. Owners pay only when they book. Providers receive the full rate they advertise.
priv2709_body: No one is shown at their exact address on the map: for your safety and privacy, every member is placed within about 1 km of their home. Only Live mode shows the real position, in real time, and only while it is switched on.
priv2709_duo_b: One blue-and-green bubble shows both rates: 🏠 sitting, 🚶 walking. If you filter a single role, only its price is shown.
priv2709_halo_b: Turquoise = PawBoost, purple = live tracking (PawFollow), pink = friend. If several apply, PawBoost comes first, then PawFollow, then friend. The gold PawPremium crown always stays visible on top.
priv2709_mefr_b: Dotted ring + crossed eye: only my friends can see me (or nobody if I'm hidden). This setting is the same in the app and on the website.
priv2709_roles_b: The “Profile” button and the photo border take the role's colour: orange = owner, blue = sitter, green = walker. Someone with several roles gets a two- or three-colour button, always in that order.

shop_boost_map_body: PawBoost puts your listing AND your profile forward. On the PawMap, your circle gets a turquoise glow with a small rocket and sits on top of the others: people see you first.
shop_boost_subtitle: Appear at the top of the list for owners looking for a sitter in your area.

signup_terms_required: Please accept the Terms of Service to continue.
sub_pf_free: Share your live position with your friends (30 min per session, app open) and follow your sitter or walker during the service.
sub_pf_plus: Sessions of 2 hours that survive closing the app, directions to any spot, walk history, and a Family plan for up to 5 people.
sub_pp_free: Free reports (lost pet, found pet, water point, vet open) and real-time alerts around you.
sub_pp_plus: Everything in PawFollow and PawSpot, all premium report types, instant notifications, unlimited chat and the crown badge on your profile.
sub_ps_free: See every PawSpot and community place on the PawMap, tag your first 3 spots for free and earn PawPoints.
sub_ps_plus: Unlimited tagging, popular spots, badges and rewards, directions included, and 20 premium reports.
sub_sub: HoPetSit is free to use. Live location sharing between friends, following your sitter or walker during the service, the PawMap and its community spots are included for everyone. Subscriptions add comfort, not the basics.
sub_title: What's free, what each subscription adds
trust_chat_body: All conversations are moderated. No emails, no off-platform tricks.
trust_id_body: Every sitter and walker can be verified. Look for the green check.
trust_map_body: 177 countries worldwide — USA included. Vets, dog parks, pet-friendly hotels, beaches, restaurants and more.
trust_pay_body: Funds are held until the service is delivered. Refunds protected.
v240_feat_family_body: Share your PawFollow plan with up to 5 trusted relatives. Everyone sees the pet, the bookings and the live position on the same map.
v240_feat_kyc_body: Sitters and walkers verify their identity with a regulated KYC partner. The blue badge appears on every profile — extra peace of mind for owners.
v240_feat_live_body: During a booking, owners can follow the walk in real time. Coloured halo: green for walkers, blue for sitters. One-tap stop, anytime.
v240_feat_pawspot_body: Tag and discover the best pet-friendly places. Earn PawPoints, climb the local leaderboards and get the golden paw 🐾 on your best spots. €4.99/month or €39.99/year, 7-day free trial.
v240_new_sub: From PawFollow Family to live tracking — designed so owners, sitters and walkers feel safe at every step.
